images.title: Midnight Arcade
images.processing: Exact byte copy of raw built-in tool output; no crop, rescale, palette reduction, color adjustment, recompression or image editing.
images.inspection: Intimate diagonal CRT-cabinet interior; foreground red joystick and six colored buttons, abstract geometric screen art, warm reflections and an open doorway onto a blue residential street with bicycle. Small stool, background cat and plain decorative pictures add discoveries. Dense cabinet wear and tiny decorations need runtime-scale inspection.

images.processing: Exact byte copy of raw built-in tool output; no crop, rescale, palette reduction, color adjustment, recompression or image editing.
images.inspection: Wide diagonal shop-and-riverside street; recognizable twin-reel VHS cassette and open case in foreground, two small convex CRTs, shelves of blank colored cases, warm blank sign panels, boxy car and rich amber/cyan/magenta rain reflections. Tiny case labels and car details show no legible text at full inspection. Highly textured reflections may compete with active game actors.

images.title: Last Train, Side B
images.processing: Exact byte copy of raw built-in tool output; no crop, rescale, palette reduction, color adjustment, recompression or image editing.
images.inspection: Close cassette player with mechanical buttons, reel window and wired foam headphones on a carriage table; patterned fabric and bag contrast with broad dusk window and receding warm station lamps. No people, legible text or branded device details observed. Player resembles a portable tabletop recorder rather than a slim personal cassette player; artistic acceptance remains open.

review.method: Direct visual inspection of each full tool-returned image, raw PNG headers and all chunk CRCs, original-to-workspace byte equality, exact prompt correspondence and SHA-256 checks. No browser, phone simulation, runtime renderer or physical device involved.
